utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the fourteenth, September. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, that last ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Unfortunately. Ten minutes of my life I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Oh, come on, you were probably shouting at the telly like the rest of us.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Never mind that, the broken coffee machine in the canteen has properly ruined my morning. Just having a moan, not putting a job in.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That explains the atmosphere. Seven people running on residual caffeine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a support group. Where did nights leave us?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah so, finished the repair on the heater box on one last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Closed off, then, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Injection Moulding Line 3 yesterday. That one's finished as well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's the line filter you're talking about, yeah? Not the other filter we've been discussing?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the Injection Moulding Line 3. Separate job, already done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the outstanding one, I'll swap the filter on the power pack on one by Wednesday. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Okay, boss, you've got the power pack on one filter, then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, mine. By Wednesday, and keep it marked urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just on nights, I noticed the Atlas was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Settled right back, or just stopped climbing?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Right back. Just an observation, nothing outstanding from that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, saw the pressure on the Arburg dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations, no new jobs off those.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I tested the trucks yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, you said yesterday? You broke up a bit.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yesterday, yeah. Testing's done, all fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Separate from that completed testing, I'll do the pre-use checks on the counterbalances tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, boss. The counterbalances pre-use checks tomorrow, got you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. Not reopening yesterday's testing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team this morning? Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Um, sorry, I can't take the toolbox talk. I can't commit to organising it this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Pricey, can you take it instead? Organise the toolbox talk for the team this morning. Still low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that off Jamie. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team this morning.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Low priority, but still this morning, just so we're not hearing two different things?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. This morning is still the timing; it's not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you inspect the water booster for leaks today as well?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll inspect the water booster for leaks today.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's an inspection, yeah? We're not saying there's a repair agreed?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Correct, just inspecting for leaks. No repair being added.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Hannah Price, can you chase the purchase order for the Fire Alarm Panel first thing tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll chase the purchase order for the Fire Alarm Panel first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, that's the purchase order chase. Separate from the parts we're still stuck waiting for.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. I'm still waiting on parts for the long belt, nothing we can do until they arrive. That remains blocked.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Same with the MV01. Still waiting on parts for the MV01, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Both stay blocked, then. We're not assigning any work on those today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: There's also the need to grease and check the bearings on the newer turbine first thing tomorrow. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I can't put my name against that, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, I can't commit to it either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, grease and check the bearings on the newer turbine, first thing tomorrow. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. That's still needing an owner.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, not one I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Nobody's taken it. Leave it visibly unowned, not against someone just because they've spoken.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you send the shift handover report round, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, that I can take. I'll send the shift handover report round if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The existing report, we're talking? Not another version?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, just sending the existing one round. No rewrite.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by Thursday as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Thanks, Saz. Monthly fire alarm test with you, by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Separate from the Fire Alarm Panel purchase order chase.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I'll update the risk assessment for work on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve at half two. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the production hold-up. It does need doing first.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Understood. At half two, and that update comes first. I'm taking it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, PR. The risk assessment for work on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve is yours at half two, with that production priority.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And that doesn't change the urgent filter timing, does it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No. The power pack on one filter is still urgent, by Wednesday. Neither timing's moved.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, someone came over you then— Teams has decided we only get one syllable each.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I heard it. Neither timing's moved. Very economical meeting if we only get syllables.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing else from me beyond what we've covered.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same here. Just glad the finished stuff isn't getting rolled over again.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And the coffee complaint remains a complaint, before anyone gets clever.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Wouldn't dream of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Cheers, everyone.
